title: Boutique Condo on Nashville's Riverfront- EVE #402
description:
Modern Living on the downtown Riverfront beautifully decorated for an out of this world stay .
WALK to Broadway, Honkey Tonks, BridgestoneArena. Country Music Hall Of Fame,Tootsies, Ryman. FREE secure parking one spot , FREE wifi , enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located space .

The space
We have 3 bedrooms and 2 and 1/2 baths 
1 bedroom is a king with en-suite bath 
2 bedroom is 1 king  
3 bedroom is a king full bath just outside the door 
1/2 bath is in the hall  
We have a few guest spots in the garage and an open lot outside the building  , fully stocked kitchen with coffee water and a local Nashville treat
There is a patio to lounge on and have your morning coffee or your evening cocktail as you watch the boats go down the river or the city skyline at night.

Guest access
The building is secure with access through our door system Latch with I will give you access to prior to your check in date it is an app with your email . If you do not have a smart phone I can generate you a code to do manually .

Other things to note
We are in an urban area close to the train and the sites and sounds of the city around us , so those noises will be heard during your stay !
